challenges.description: Construct full URL: <hlt>url = protocol + "://" + domain + "/" + endpoint + "?q=" + query</hlt> and print.
challenges.starter_code:
protocol = "https"
domain = "api.learner.dev"
endpoint = "search"
query = "python"
# Stage 2: Full API Endpoint URL
